thread:
Priya CSM: Heads up 8h before Aurelia Health goes live. Finance flagged cost variance in trial + execs are worried about UX during renewal demo. Can we assemble a 1-page Day0 customer-facing runbook that they can follow (and we can run in parallel)? Need quick items for prefill, client batching, streaming fallbacks, and a simple way to capture impact metrics for renewal reporting.

Jon CS-Ops: I can draft a compact runbook with copy/paste toggles. Keep it 'customer-friendly' and add an internal checklist for CS to run post-deploy. I'll start with bullet steps 0.

Rae SRE: Quick baseline questions: what model variant are they on and are they using server-side streaming? That changes recommended thresholds.

Priya CSM: They're on dedicated 7B-q4 and streaming enabled on conversational routes. Traffic pattern: short interactions, many retries on quick UI events.

Tom Eng: Okay, here's a customer-facing Day0 runbook (one-liner steps they can run or we can toggle):

```
Day0 Runbook (customer-facing):
1) Enable tenant warm_pool: Settings > Performance > Warm Pools -> toggle ON.
2) Prefill top intents: Set "prefill.intents" = [greet, search, summarize, billing]; cadence = 30m.
3) Lightweight prefix cache: set prefix_ttl = 10m for session prompts, prefix_ttl = 1h for billing templates.
4) Client batching: client_window_ms = 25 (jitter +/-10ms), max_batch = 48.
5) Streaming guardrail: stream_threshold_ms = 700 -> if generation time > threshold, client should switch to fallback streaming_model = "7B-lite-q4".
6) Cost guardrail: enable "cost_alert" at +15% over baseline week.
7) Telemetry: export p50/p95/p99, token_cost, and request_rate to shared dashboard.
8) Permission: enable "CS warm-pool assist" checkbox so Redwood can run warmup job for up to 72h when authorized.
```

Jon CS-Ops: Internal CS checklist (short) to run after deploy: 1) confirm warm_pool active, 2) run 10 synthetic prefills across intents, 3) verify p95 < 400ms and p99 < 1.2s for core routes, 4) confirm token cost delta <= 12% vs baseline. Add go/no-go column for next-day follow-up.

Nina PM: For renewal reporting, we need a simple capture method: collect pre/post metrics at T-24h and T+48h (p95, p99, tokens, errors). Jon, can you add a CSV template we can share with the customer?

Jon CS-Ops: Yes. CSV columns: timestamp, route, p50_ms, p95_ms, p99_ms, tokens, requests, error_rate, notes. We'll ask them to send daily snapshots for the trial window.

Rae SRE: Ops tips for Dedicated: run an automated warmup job at 03:30 UTC for business hours. Command: `rbctl warmup --tenant aurelia --slots 4 --intents-file top_intents.json --at 03:30` and schedule a health-check job: `rbctl health --tenant aurelia --route /generate --samples 5`. Also add auto-scale down policy: scale_to_zero_after = 72h no-traffic.

Tom Eng: Small engineering note: if client latency remains noisy, reduce client_window_ms to 10ms and max_batch to 24; this favors latency consistency over batch efficiency. We'll document as alternative.

Priya CSM: Capture plan for customer feedback during kickoff: 1) ask them to mark perceived regressions in the shared doc (good/bad/neutral) after each test, 2) collect 3 example prompts that saw regression, 3) grant CS permission to run one warm-pool trial.

ops-bot: scheduled warmup job for tenant aurelia at 2026-03-24T03:30:00Z (4 slots) 026-03-24T03:30:00Z created by Jon CS-Ops

Jon CS-Ops: I'll convert the Day0 runbook + CSV template into a single-page PDF for the kickoff and include the internal CS checklist. Will ping here with the file.

Nina PM: For renewal risk scoring, we'll flag this customer as 'monitor-high' and require a follow-up review 7 days after go-live with the metrics CSV. If numbers improve, move to 'ontrack'.

Priya CSM: Thanks team 1. This is the exact material I need for tomorrow's demo. I'll share the one-pager and ask for the warm-pool assist consent in the kickoff.

Jon CS-Ops: PDF attached in thread (will add link). Also adding short playbook note: if p99 > 1.5s for 10m, escalate to #urgent-onboard with full metric dump.

Rae SRE: And add auto-scale guard: if cost_alert & low-traffic, auto-scale down warm-pool and notify CS.

Priya CSM: Perfect. Closing loop 7. Ib4ll update the renewal board after the first 48h metrics come in. :rocket:
